Grading (held as `finding`, type Task) — 本评论来自分诊座位 Routine.

**Held, with a named re-grade trigger.** All three dispositions touch the published surface (un-exporting is technically breaking even if practically inert; publishing `StrictObjectOptions` widens the public face), so the call belongs to the maintainer — but with zero measured pull and no consumer able to use the export in a typed way today, it does not earn a decision-inbox slot now. Leave-and-note is the correct interim state, and this card is the note.

**Re-grade trigger:** when a v18 major-train ADR-0087 removal batch opens (the #5082 family is the anchor), surface this card into that batch — the un-export-vs-publish decision rides the major with the rest of the retirement registry, where it costs the maintainer one line instead of a standalone ruling.
